Since the domain of integration $R=[0,2]\times [0,e]\times [0,1]$ is a rectangular box and the integrand can be expressed as $f(x)\cdot g(y)\cdot h(z),$ we can rewrite our repeated integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{e}{e}^{-z}\,dy\,dz\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{2}dx{\int }_{0}^{e}dy{\int }_{0}^{1}{e}^{-z}\,dz\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating each integral separately, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}dx{\int }_{0}^{e}dy{\int }_{0}^{1}{e}^{-z}\,dz & =(2-0)\cdot (e-0)\cdot [-{e}^{-z}]_{0}^{1} \\  & =2\cdot e\cdot (-{e}^{-1}+{e}^{0}) \\  & =2e(1-{e}^{-1}) \\  & =2e-2.\end{aligned}
$$
